title: Pickaxe rework: 3D pick, block breaking, running crater swing
desc: J's note on 844 P1a: a more 3D but thin and dense pick, new block destruction with physical drops, light particles, new arm animations, and running through with the pick breaking about 8 blocks a swing in a small dome crater, not instantly. Three new pick designs mining a block each (P1a1-3), and three running-through takes (R1-3).

takes.name: Faceted crescent pick: three quick taps, the third breaks
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; faceted crescent pick; pixel stream build (frames 1-15); hits at frames 19, 23, 28, 44, 48, 53; blocks break at frames 30, 55 into 6 physical chunks each

takes.name: Laminated pick: forehand, backhand, the cracks creep between
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; laminated pick; pixel stream build (frames 1-15); hits at frames 21, 29, 47, 55; blocks break at frames 32, 58 into 6 physical chunks each

takes.name: Shell-and-core pick: heavy strike, crack spreads, pry bursts it
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; shell-and-core pick; pixel stream build (frames 1-15); hits at frames 25, 52; blocks break at frames 31, 58 into 6 physical chunks each

takes.name: Running chops: overhead every 9 ticks, 8-block dome craters
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; faceted crescent pick; runs in, 7 swings every 9 ticks, hits at frames 19, 28, 37, 46, 55, 64, 73; each swing cracks 8 blocks (56 in all), 5 ticks of cracking before they break into 4 physical chunks each

takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; shell-and-core pick; runs in, 6 swings every 10 ticks, hits at frames 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70; each swing cracks 8 blocks (48 in all), 6 ticks of cracking before they break into 4 physical chunks each
